executive_decision.one_paragraph_thesis_en: Gold is trading at $4520, up 0.85%, reflecting strong buying momentum. The weakening DXY at 99.09 adds bullish pressure, supporting further upside. Key pull‑back entry zones lie around $4490‑$4500, offering attractive risk‑adjusted entries. Risk management calls for a stop‑loss below $4470 and a 1:2 risk‑reward target near $4560.
